digest.component_or_area: Jira Cloud / Data Center adapter layer
propositions: Cloud REST v3 requires Atlassian Document Format (JSON) while Data Center REST v2 uses plain text/wiki markup, causing duplication of the rich-text encoding path across adapters
Today ADF encoding is hardwired into the Cloud path via adf.py; PR #120 copied map_fields_to_remote and changed one line, requiring a contract abstraction to prevent ongoing duplication

A four-operation RichTextCodec protocol (fit_outbound, normalize_outbound, to_wire, decode_inbound) is needed because Cloud has two distinct call paths that differ in whether they compose fit+normalize or fit alone, and collapsing them would change observable behavior

The protocol must be defined in jira_family/rich_text.py (vendor-neutral), AdfCodec in jira/rich_text_codec.py (Cloud-side), and WikiTextCodec in jira_family/rich_text.py to enforce J2's import contract that jira_family imports nothing from jira/

Exactly one real implementation of map_fields_to_remote must exist in adapters/jira_family/outbound_mapper.py taking the codec as a constructor dependency, with backend.py and jira_fields.py delegating or reaching through the codec rather than calling ADF functions directly
